decisionsTitle: «Cronometrare» asks before a finished elite's number typed again is recorded, at the moment of the tap (amending §986)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, the day before the race:** «Also, improvements: after an elite arrives and is marked as a finisher, if somebody types that again than we need a confirmation message, this is just for elites sincer their timing is more sensitive». A number pressed twice was already harmless on the server (§986: the first «Sosit» stays, the second press goes to «Istoricul sosirilor»), but an elite's time is the one the race is watched for, and an elite's number typed in the box after the elite's own button turned green is far more often a slip — a digit mistyped, a volunteer at the same phone who did not see the button turn — than a second crossing.

**Decision.**

1. **Asked first, in the box.** When the number typed in «Numărul de pe BIB» (Enter or «Sosit») is an elite's — a registration marked «Elită» or a numbered line of the race's elite list, as the page's state holds them — and that elite is already «Sosit» as this page last heard — at its load, or in the answer to any press of its own since —, or the phone already holds the signed-in account's own press of that number since the gun the line counts from, waiting to leave or saved and not undone (`domain/finish-line.ts#asksBeforeAgain`), nothing is recorded yet. The house's one dialog (`ConfirmDialog`, §384) asks «{label} ({name}) a sosit deja la {time} — introdus de {by}. Treci numărul din nou?» — who entered it as «Ultimii sosiți» says it («modificat de» once «Clasament» changed it, «cont șters» for an account gone), left out while the elite is not among them —, says «Al doilea timp nu-l schimbă pe primul: apare doar în «Istoricul sosirilor», la «Clasament».», and offers two answers of at least 44 pixels, one under the other at 320 pixels: «Anulează», focused, and «Trece numărul din nou» in the error colour of a press the trail keeps for good (`destructive`), so Enter never answers it: a second Enter reaches the focused «Anulează», as Esc and the backdrop do. The words ask of the number, never of the person — the race's elites are men and women, and a masculine «Îl treci din nou?» would read wrong of «Ioana» —; in English «Enter the number again?» and «Enter the number again». They are in both catalogues (`Admin.timing.eliteAgain.*`, each under 200 characters), handed to the island by the page as its other words.
2. **The moment is the tap's.** The moment a press stands for is read when «Sosit» is pressed (`tapMoment`: the oldest kept «Finish» moment still young, else now on the server's clock) and handed to the press, which only then lets go of the kept moment it read (`keptAfterPress`). «Trece numărul din nou» records that moment however long the question stayed open — never the moment of the answer — and the server answers it a duplicate as before; «Anulează» records nothing and leaves the kept moment to the next number. A kept moment the second's sweep dropped for paper while the question was open still goes to that press, and leaves the paper line. The box is empty and focused either way. Only the open question's first answer counts, and the dialog stays drawn while it fades, so a double tap answers once and never reaches the button under it. An elite's button and a number nobody asks about take their moment the same way, at the tap.
3. **The box's focus, inside the answer's tap.** iOS Safari raises the keyboard only for a focus a tap's own handler gives, never for one given a frame later, and a volunteer who must tap the box again loses the next runner. The answer's handler closes the question at once (`flushSync` — while it is open, the dialog's focus trap pulls any focus outside it back in) and gives the box the focus there and then; a frame later it gives it once more, in case the dialog's own return of the focus, or a second tap on it as it fades — which in most browsers moves the focus to the button it lands on —, moved it since.
4. **Only elites, only the box.** Any other number typed again, and an elite who has not crossed yet, go at once as before. An elite's own button stays disabled once «Sosit», as §986 drew it; a page that had not heard yet still sends its press, which the server answers as a duplicate. Another account's press left on the phone, a press undone since and a press before the gun — the trial before «Resetează clasamentul» (§997) — ask nothing. With scripts off there is no question: the plain form posts and the server keeps the first time.
5. The guide's «Cronometrare» step that explains a number pressed twice gains a sentence — the question, on this phone once the page knows the elite crossed (after any press of the volunteer's or a reload), and a second press never changing the first time anyway — and so does the runbook's step at the finish.

**Refused.** A question for every number typed twice: the owner asked for the elites alone, and a bunch finish has no time for a question per runner. A question on the elite's own button, drawn disabled once «Sosit». Words of the person — «Îl treci din nou?», «Trece-l din nou» —: masculine, and the elites are men and women.

**Not in this change.** The server — a duplicate stays harmless, kept in the trail —, the other numbers, the elites' buttons and «Clasament». **A second phone that has not heard yet** is not asked: the question knows what this phone's page knows — the line as its load or the answer to its own last press drew it, and its own presses — so a phone whose page heard nothing since the elite crossed elsewhere (no press of its own answered since, no reload) records the number at once, and the server keeps the first time and writes that press to «Istoricul sosirilor», as before this change. Asking the server at every number typed would put a round trip between the box and the next runner on the line, where a bunch finish has no second for it; and the page re-reads the line on no timer — the half-minute question before the first finisher carries the gun alone (§986).
changelogLine: - **«Cronometrare» asks before an elite is entered twice** — on a phone whose page knows an elite is already «Sosit», the elite's number typed in the box opens a question first: «Anulează» (focused, so Enter or Esc) records nothing and keeps a caught «Finish» moment for the next number, «Trece numărul din nou» records the moment «Sosit» was pressed and the first time stays, and the box has the focus — the phone its keypad — back at once; any other number goes at once as before. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 294 for an elite already in. Given «Cronometrare» with scripts on, when the number typed in «Numărul de pe BIB» and sent by Enter or «Sosit» is that of an elite on the page — a registration marked «Elită» or a numbered line of the race's elite list — already «Sosit» as the page last heard it, at its load or in the answer to any press of its own since, or one of which the signed-in account's own press since the gun waits or was saved on that phone, then nothing is recorded yet and the house's confirmation dialog asks «<label> (<name>) a sosit deja la <time> — introdus de <staff name>. Treci numărul din nou?» (who entered it only while the elite is among «Ultimii sosiți»), says «Al doilea timp nu-l schimbă pe primul: apare doar în «Istoricul sosirilor», la «Clasament».», and offers «Anulează», focused, and «Trece numărul din nou», each at least 44 pixels tall and inside a 320-pixel screen, in Romanian and in English — words of the number, the same for a woman as for a man (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`; integration `results/timing-page.test.ts`; e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Given that question, when it is answered «Anulează», a second Enter, Esc or the backdrop, then nothing is recorded, no kept «Finish» moment is used and the box is empty and focused; when it is answered «Trece numărul din nou», then the number is pressed at the moment read when «Sosit» was pressed — the oldest kept «Finish» moment still young, else that instant on the server's clock — never at the answer, the server keeping the first time and writing the second to the trail as for any number pressed twice; only the open question's first answer counts; and after either answer the box holds the focus by the time the answer's tap ends — given inside the tap, so a phone raises its keypad again —, a second tap on the question as it fades included (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`; e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.

Given «Cronometrare», when the number typed is no elite's, or that of an elite who has not crossed yet, or of one whose crossing on another phone this page has not heard of — no press of its own answered since and no reload —, then it is pressed at once with no question, as before, the server keeping an elite's first time all the same; an elite's own button stays disabled once «Sosit» and never asks; another account's press left on the phone, a press undone since and a press before the gun ask nothing; with scripts off the plain form posts with no question (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-line.test.ts`; e2e `race-finish-quick.spec.ts`.
